newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cerebos New Zealand unit to merge.
newsitem.headline: Cerebos New Zealand unit to merge.

text.p: Cerebos Pacific Ltd said on Wednesday its New Zealand subsidiary had entered an agreement to merge its Ready to Drink fruit juice/fruit drink business with New Zealand company, Rio Beverages Ltd.
Equity investment of its New Zealand subsidiary, Cerebos Gregg's Ltd, and Rio would be at NZ$4.2 million, a Cerebos statement said.
The 50-50 joint venture company would have an estimated turnover of NZ$32 million per year and would acquire the stocks, fixed assets, trade marks and good will of the two companies.

The joint venture company would also distribute and/or contract pack for third parties, Cerebos said. Cerebos said managing director of Rio, David Thexton, would be appointed chief executive of the joint venture.
